shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' | head -80 && printf '\\nTop-level:\\n' && ls -la && printf '\\nFiles:\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n.gitignore:\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\nInstalled top-level packages:\\n' && ls node_modules | head -60 && printf '\\nGit status:\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest lucide-react@latest && node -v && npm ls next react react-dom lucide-react --depth=0'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
for route in / /books/new /books/sample-creative-act /books/sample-psalm-wild-built /books/does-not-exist; do
  result=$(curl --silent --output /tmp/reading-shelf-http.html --write-out '"'%{http_code}' \"http://localhost:3100"'$route")
  printf '"'%-36s %s\\n' \""'$route" "$result"
  if [ "$route" = '"'/books/does-not-exist' ]; then test \""'$result" = 404; else test "$result" = 200; fi
done
curl --silent http://localhost:3100/ | rg -o '"'Currently reading|Finished books|The Creative Act|A Psalm for the Wild-Built' | sort -u
curl --silent http://localhost:3100/books/sample-creative-act | rg -o 'A gentle reminder to pay attention to the little things|Copy book link|Mark as finished' | sort -u
printf '\\nAction input names:\\n'
curl --silent http://localhost:3100/books/new | rg -o 'name=\"\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+'"' | head -2
"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
backup=$(mktemp)
cp data/books.json "$backup"
trap '"'cp \""'$backup" data/books.json'"' EXIT
add_action="'$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3100/books/new | rg -o '"'\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+'"' | head -1)
test -n \""'$add_action"
add_status=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-shelf-add-response -w '"'%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3100' -F \""'${add_action}=" -F '"'title=Integration Test Book' -F 'author=Integration Author' -F 'notes=A note that persists.' http://localhost:3100/books/new)
id="'$(node --input-type=module -e "import fs from '"'node:fs'; const books=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')); console.log(books.find(book=>book.title==='Integration Test Book')?.id??'')\")
test -n \""'$id"
detail=$(curl -fsS "http://localhost:3100/books/$id")
printf '"'%s' \""'$detail" | rg -q '"'A note that persists\\.'
finish_action="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$detail" | rg -o '"'\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+'"' | head -1)
test -n \""'$finish_action"
finish_status=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-shelf-finish-response -w '"'%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3100' -F \""'${finish_action}=" -F "id=${id}" "http://localhost:3100/books/$id")
node --input-type=module -e "import fs from '"'node:fs'; const book=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')).find(book=>book.id==='"'$id'"'); if ("'!book?.finishedAt) process.exit(1); console.log('"'Book added, notes persisted, and book marked finished on disk');\"
printf 'Add response: %s, finish response: %s, direct book page: 200\\n' \""'$add_status" "$finish_status"'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: app/layout.jsx @@ -

There is no friend as loyal as a book.

- — ERNEST HEMINGWAY +

The best stories stay with us.

+ — A LITTLE REMINDER *** End Patch PATCH node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs'; const books=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')); if (books.length "'!== 4 || books.some(book=>book.title==='"'Integration Test Book')) process.exit(1); console.log('Sample data restored: 4 books');\" git diff --check && npm run build && printf '\\nChanged files:\\n' && git status --short"
